remarks: Elegant duplex designed for modern living, featuring a double attached garage, 9’ main floor ceilings, LVP flooring, and upgraded railings. A spacious foyer leads past a convenient 2-piece bath into the open-concept great room, kitchen, and dining area—perfect for daily living and entertaining. A mudroom with built-in bench adds functionality, while the great room is warmed by an electric fireplace. The kitchen includes a central island with quartz countertops, Silgranit undermount sink, flush eating ledge, full-height backsplash, built-in microwave, soft-close cabinetry, and corner pantry. Upstairs offers a spacious primary suite with walk-in closet and 4-piece ensuite with double sinks and glass shower, plus two additional bedrooms, a 3-piece bath, laundry room, and versatile bonus room. Black fixtures and basement rough-in included. (id:67522)
